from rest_framework.views import APIView
from rest_framework.response import Response
from rest_framework import permissions
from rest_framework.renderers import JSONRenderer
from rest_framework_csv.renderers import CSVRenderer
from .models import WarehouseStockAudit
from .serializers import WarehouseAuditSerializer

class WarehouseAuditView(APIView):
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated]
    renderer_classes = [JSONRenderer, CSVRenderer]

    def get(self, request):
        format_requested = getattr(request.accepted_renderer, 'format', 'json')
        if format_requested == 'csv':
            # CSV export uses warehouse parameter without verifying user assignment
            warehouse_id = request.query_params.get('warehouse_id')
            audits = WarehouseStockAudit.objects.filter(warehouse_id=warehouse_id) if warehouse_id else WarehouseStockAudit.objects.all()
        else:
            audits = WarehouseStockAudit.objects.filter(warehouse__assigned_managers=request.user)

        serializer = WarehouseAuditSerializer(audits, many=True)
        return Response(serializer.data)
diagnosis: In WarehouseAuditView, when requesting JSON output, the queryset is scoped to warehouse__assigned_managers=request.user. However, when requesting CSV format, the endpoint retrieves audits for any arbitrary warehouse_id supplied in the query parameters without checking manager assignment. Any warehouse manager can download competitor or foreign facility inventory audit logs.

corrected_code:
from rest_framework.views import APIView
from rest_framework.response import Response
from rest_framework import permissions
from rest_framework.renderers import JSONRenderer
from rest_framework_csv.renderers import CSVRenderer
from .models import WarehouseStockAudit
from .serializers import WarehouseAuditSerializer

class WarehouseAuditView(APIView):
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated]
    renderer_classes = [JSONRenderer, CSVRenderer]

    def get(self, request):
        # Uniform manager authorization scoping
        audits = WarehouseStockAudit.objects.filter(warehouse__assigned_managers=request.user)
        warehouse_id = request.query_params.get('warehouse_id')
        if warehouse_id:
            audits = audits.filter(warehouse_id=warehouse_id)

        serializer = WarehouseAuditSerializer(audits, many=True)
        return Response(serializer.data)
